answer.rationale: Climbing p99 latency on the write path coinciding with a release 2 hours ago is the most direct signal of causality. Rollback has the fastest time-to-value for write path recovery (memory_b1: cleared error spike without customer impact). Regional failover is contraindicated because writes are heavy and at daily peak—memory_b2 explicitly warns against failover during hot writes and resulted in replication gaps and lost writes. Adding capacity is slower and doesn't address the likely code regression. Circuit breaker and read replica routing address symptoms, not root cause. Memory_b1 and memory_b6 together show rollback+staging are effective; verifying memory_b1 (rollback path) and memory_b2 (failover hazard) de-risks the decision.
